text:
elaine: heads up — BetaNova POC just hit a cluster of 429s at 12:00 local during a scripted load run. They said it looks like burst limits kicking in every minute. Demo stalled. cc @mike @tariq @sofia @ana

mike: Can you paste a few gateway lines? Curious if it's per-route or global token-bucket expiry.

elaine: snippet:
```
[1747129999.001] req=rq1 user=betanova route=/v1/generate tokens=480 status=200
[1747130000.000] req=rq2 user=betanova route=/v1/generate tokens=150 status=429 reason=burst_limit
[1747130001.200] req=rq3 user=betanova route=/v1/generate tokens=120 status=429 reason=burst_limit
[1747130045.500] req=rq4 user=betanova route=/v1/generate tokens=40 status=200
```
Looks like bursts are allowed then minute boundary kills them.

tariq: check tenant quota config: `GET /internal/tenants/betanova/quotas`

elaine: config: `{
  "monthly_tokens":"5000000",
  "token_bucket":{
    "capacity":1000,
    "refill_rate_per_sec":8,
    "burst_window_seconds":60,
    "per_route_caps":{"/v1/generate":800}
  }
}`

mike: refill_rate_per_sec=8 => 480 tokens/minute. Their scripted run had sequences of ~600 tokens per minute. So bucket empties and then the per-route enforcement denies followups. But why do some requests pass right at minute boundary? Race between refill ticker and request processing.

sofia: Customer says their demo uses many short calls (200-400 tokens each) in quick succession. They expected smoothing. Is there a way to allow short transient bursts for POC?

ana: (billing) They also asked whether we bill for denied requests (they saw usage increments). Need clarification before we issue any credits.

mike: We don't bill for requests that fully fail with 429, but partial charges can appear if child calls completed. We'll run a query.

(tariq) Root cause: our token-bucket refill is coarse-grained — we refill once per second, but burst_window_seconds logic clamps per-route allowance using integer math. When many concurrent requests compete the bucket drains in microseconds and we hit per-route cap enforcement in gateway which is independent. Need two fixes: 1) smoother refill (sub-second fractional tokens) and 2) change per-route enforcement to use moving-window average over burst_window rather than hard minute-buckets.

mike: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- temp: increase capacity to 2000 or set refill_rate_per_sec to 20 for betanova for the demo.
- emergency URL param: `?burst_smooth=true` to bypass minute clamp for requests with `demo=true` header.
- longer term: update token-bucket to use float math + leaky-bucket algorithm.

deploy-bot: Incident opened INC-2026-612: betanova POC burst-limit (assignee: mike).

elaine: BetaNova asked about product pricing if they need sustained 2k tpm. Can we give quick guidance?

ana: For sustained 2k tokens/min that's ~2.88M tokens/month. Our sales trial pricing is usage-based; recommend quoting them our standard hosted tier plus 10% POC add-on for burst capacity. I'll DM details.

sofia: Can we do the temp bump now? They're in a customer meeting.

mike: Doing temp bump: `PATCH /internal/tenants/betanova/quotas` payload `{
  "token_bucket": {"capacity":2000, "refill_rate_per_sec":20}
}` — applied at 1747130105.

elaine: applied, customer confirmed demo resumed. They asked for a short note explaining why it happened to share with infra team.

tariq: I'll open a PR for smoothing: PR#5720 — changes:
- swap ticker to 100ms granularity
- store token_balance as float64 in redis
- per-route enforcement uses sliding window counter over burst_window_seconds
Expected staging deploy in 30m.

mike: ran diagnostics to compute whether overcharge occurred:
```
SELECT event_id, request_id, tokens_charged, status FROM token_events
WHERE tenant='betanova' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-22 11:50' AND now()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200;
```
Prelim: 0 completed requests with 429 billed. We'll refund if we find any anomalies.

elaine: thanks all — I'll follow up with BetaNova with: short explainer, promise of follow-up once PR merges, and confirmation of temp bump and billing check. :white_check_mark:
